title: What do you think about my halloween costumes in game?
author: PuzzleheadedBlood184
selftext:
Hey Everyone, as some of you know that I am building my game in 3 months from scratch. I have 200$ worth of laptop and that's all. I am spending a lot of time on it right now because I don't have money or friends 😂

Yesterday I decided to work on Halloween in the kitchen and mafia jobs. Here is one of the maps that we bust mafia's costume party. -- Because my laptop is not able to run video recorders I had to clear the level so I don't need to use the mouse then record the video with other hand otherwise mafia were getting me.. 🥲

1st year - Plague Doctor  
2st - Serialkiller clown  
3rd - Zombie  
4th - Scary pumpkinhead farmer

These are our costumes for the game. Game loop is setup on 4 year calendar so you won't need more costumes 🎃. Or what should be the costumes?

I am also gonna share how the kitchen looks in Halloween, in replies below. 

Let me know your thoughts guys!
